summary: Performance fix: hashtag timelines (TagFeed, used by /tags/:id and the hashtag timeline API) now also filter the statuses_tags join by the pagination cursor (max_id/since_id/min_id), so multi-tag (any[]) feeds paged with min_id stop being slow. Same results, faster; plus tests.

statements.why: Query-only speed-up; statuses_tags is always joined via tagged_with (status.rb:142), no access, data or secret change.

statements.text: The tag part of your server now reads status. /tags/[id]
statements.why: Hashtag feeds already read posts; the change only adds an extra cursor filter to make paging faster (tag_feed.rb:64-70). An owner would think the page started reading new data.

misses.what: Hashtag timelines that combine several tags (any[]) load faster when scrolling/refreshing (speed fix, same results).
